strings: m_c's headaches have plagued {PRONOUN/m_c/object} particularly badly this moon, so much so that r_c0 is running low on {PRONOUN/r_c0/poss} pain-relieving mixture, having used so much up in keeping m_c feeling able.
m_c growls as another wave of pain hits {PRONOUN/m_c/object}. It's on-and-off; herbs have been helping, but StarClan help {PRONOUN/m_c/object}, having so many headaches gets annoying.
